campaign.formal_request_count_note: Paper only says 6K; no bound artifact establishing 6000 versus 6144 was recovered. 6000, K=1024, seed20261023 and explicit with-replacement sampling are campaign conventions; no claim to recover original request list.
campaign.primary_metric: Wall time from first network submission attempt until all response bodies are fully received; parsing/validation excluded. All requests eligible at once on both systems.
campaign.fixed_length_test: Enable only after both engines demonstrate equivalent EOS/length enforcement
campaign.real_task_test: Allow EOS; compare actual lengths and quality alongside completion time
campaign.host_memory_note: 675 GiB weights + initial 64 GiB host KV; tune KV upward only after measuring peaks. Original 256 GiB example leaves limited runtime headroom on 1 TiB.
